limitations: Exactly two predetermined observations on a standard Brownian path
A single exactly shared Gaussian calibration offset and no independent per-sample error
No extension claimed to partial correlation, random offset drift, adaptive sampling, arbitrary kernels or more than two readings
The related 2019 Kalman sampling continuation was not inspected in full text.
scientific_integrity: The claim is a new conditional-Gaussian design theorem with an analytic proof and supporting computational checks; it is not independently certified and historical priority is not guaranteed.
title: A discontinuous calibration threshold for two common-offset Brownian quadrature samples
